subnets.description: List of all active subnet IDs (Must include the primary/default subnet).

items.description: List of all active subnet IDs (Must include the primary/default subnet).

ScaleConfigRequest.description: Configuration payload for Multi-AZ Autoscale Load Balancer

minSize.description: Minimum number of instances. If null, backend defaults to number of subnets.

healthCheckPath.description: Health check path for the HTTP protocol.

healthCheckMethod.description: Health check method for the HTTP protocol.

healthyThreshold.description: Healthy threshold. The value must be in range from 2 to 10.

unhealthyThreshold.description: Unhealthy threshold. The value must be in range from 2 to 10.

timeout.description: Timeout of health check. The value must be from 2 to 120 seconds.

interval.description: Health check interval. The value must be from 5 to 3600 seconds.

successCode.description: Health check success code for HTTP health check protocol.

domainName.description: Domain name for HTTP health check protocol.

httpVersion.description: Http version for HTTP health check protocol.

algorithm.description: Algorithm of the pool. The algorithm can be "ROUND_ROBIN" or "LEAST_CONNECTIONS" or "SOURCE_IP"

members.description: List of members of the pool.

ChangeMembersRequest.description: Request to update members of a pool

port.description: Port of the server to handle request.

weight.description: Weight for the member. Higher weight will make that member receive more requests.

name.description: Friendly name for the member to be recognizable.

Header.description: Header key-value pair to be inserted into requests

defaultPoolId.description: Id of the pool that this listener will forward to.

timeoutClient.description: Idle timeout of client. The value can be in range from 1 to 3600 seconds

timeoutConnection.description: Idle timeout of connection. The value can be in range from 1 to 3600 seconds

insertHeaders.description: List of headers to insert. Each header object must include a 'headerName' and a 'headerValue'.

items.description: List of ALPN protocols supported by this listener. ALPN allows negotiation of protocols like HTTP/1.1 or H2 over secure connections.

tlsSecurityPolicy.description: TLS security policy for the listener. It can be one of the predefined policies.

policies.description: List of policies to reorder, start from 1 to ...

keepQueryString.description: Keep the query string or not.

name.description: Policy name. Only letters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_', '-') are allowed and must be between 5 and 50 characters.

action.description: Action. This indicates how the listener will route traffic. The value can be REDIRECT_TO_POOL or REDIRECT_TO_URL.

redirectHttpCode.description: Redirect HTTP code for redirecting to other URL.

keepQueryString.description: Keep the query string or not.

rules.description: List of rules of the policy.

CreateL7PolicyRequest.description: Request model for creating L7 policy

defaultCertificateId.description: Default Certificate that the listener will use

Certificates.description: Certificates configuration for the load balancer listener

name.description: Load balancer's name. Only letters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_','-', '.') are allowed and your input data must be between 5 and 50 characters.

packageId.description: Package ID of the load balancer.

certificateChain.description: A certificate chain is an ordered list of certificates, containing an SSL/TLS Certificate and (CA) Certificates, that enable the receiver to verify that the sender and all CA's are trustworthy.

passphrase.description: The password of the private key.

type.description: Type of the certificate (CA or TLS/SSL)
